description.en: The name of the index template.

descriptions.zh: > 删除索引模板前，请先删除关联该索引模板的数据流。否则，将无法删除对应的索引模板。
descriptions.en: > Before deleting an index template, delete the data streams associated with the index template. Otherwise, the index template cannot be deleted.
